onboarding.collectionStep1: Welcome to your Closet! Tap "Add Piece" to upload your first garment with the camera or from your gallery, and let the AI identify it.
onboarding.stylesStep1: "My Looks" holds every combination created by you or by the AI, organised by category.
onboarding.stylesStep2: In "Style Prompt" you describe your personal vision, and "Tags" lets you organise your looks your own way.
onboarding.stylesStep3: "Full Body" and "Colorimetry" store the information the AI uses to suggest better styles for you.
onboarding.secondLifeStep1: "Vitrina" shows the garments you've listed, filterable by For Sale, Gift, Trade or Completed.
onboarding.secondLifeStep2: "Explore" shows other users' garments: save the ones you like with the heart and message the owner to arrange things.
onboarding.secondLifeStep3: "My Impact" shows the positive impact you make on the environment by reusing.
onboarding.scheduleStep1: Create a plan with its motive, dates and, if you travel, its destination: we'll show you the weather forecast to draw inspiration from.
onboarding.scheduleStep2: Then schedule outfits on the plan's dates: if it has a destination, your "Suitcase" fills up with the exact garments you need to pack.
onboarding.discoverStep1: The Catalog uses AI to generate recommendations for new pieces based on your closet and your style.
onboarding.discoverStep2: Use the "Visual" tab to upload a photo of a garment you like and find where to get similar options.
onboarding.discoverStep3: And in the "Combinator" PRO mode, pick garments from your closet and the AI will combine them onto your avatar.
onboarding.savedStep1: This is where the posts you bookmarked are kept, and you can filter them by colour.
onboarding.savedStep2: The "Estilo" button shows you the look's keywords and copies its AI prompt so you can reuse it.
onboarding.savedStep3: "Market" analyses the post and lists the garments and accessories that make up the look.
